seasonalTasks.title: Winter pruning (dormant)
seasonalTasks.body: Cane prune to four-arm Kniffin or umbrella Kniffin. Remove most of last year's wood.

seasonalTasks.title: Shoot thinning at 5 to 7 in
seasonalTasks.body: Remove non-count shoots and weak shoots from cordon to balance crop.

seasonalTasks.title: Concord harvest
seasonalTasks.body: At least 16° Brix (the juice processor minimum) + characteristic foxy aroma. Single-pass mechanical or hand.

notes: Slip-skin American grape — juice + jam. Most disease-tolerant of common cultivars.

animalToxicity.note: Grapes and raisins can cause kidney failure in dogs.
